crossConcepts.reason: The selected primary PT_FUNCTION_EXTREMUM already covers finding an extremum by the vertex/complete-square form. Those operations locate which point minimizes x²−2kx+5k on 0≤x≤4, so CC_VERTEX and CC_COMPLETE_SQUARE would duplicate the primary method rather than add a separate concept.

sourceMathCheck: k<0 and k>4 cannot give minimum 6; for 0≤k≤4, −k²+5k=6 gives k=2,3, both in range.
